question: Does numerical refinement through the full zero-gravity assembly and gravity drape path change the observed weak-warp strain sensitivity, compared with the retained continuation-only experiment?

cases.name: control_8x32
cases.start: separate fresh Cloth from identical original mesh positions, zero velocities, t=0 and original seam targets

cases.start: separate fresh Cloth from identical original mesh positions, zero velocities, t=0 and original seam targets

protocol.contact: all supported collider/cloth contacts on; production bridge unchanged

checks.independent_measurement: measure.py reconstructs deformation gradient from retained UV/triangle/position arrays, rotates by authored grain, measures signed warp/weft length strain with no solver calls; also calculates mass-weighted drift, sampled-stitch gaps and avatar/ground capsule penetration geometrically
checks.independent_self_checks: hand-derived 45-degree 1.2x U stretch, unrotated strain/energy, unequal-mass drift, weighted seam and capsule geometry passed before any solver output
checks.retained_control_sample_comparison: compare independent strains, positions and velocities at every shared sampled simulated time 0..3 s; report differences without rewriting old outputs
checks.sensitivity_comparisons: each refinement versus full-path control at identical global frames; absolute difference of independent max-axis strain, maximum and mass-weighted RMS nodal drift; also velocity differences
checks.prior_continuation_context: Prior branches all start from t=3s baseline positions and velocities, so only their t=3s initial state is same-time comparable with new terminal outputs. Old t=4s sensitivity remains separately labeled continuation-only; new experiment stops at t=3s.

non_goals: No convergence from one factor-of-two refinement
No mesh refinement or threshold/material/fixture tuning
No native UI, proprietary research, reference calibration or parity claim
No production/source/registry/docs changes, CI or Pages
No broad sweep or extra continuation
